subject: Civic Education
competence: Controls the emotions in such a way that it safeguards the existence of a democratic society.
unique_learning_outcome: Describes the nature of various kinds of emotions occurring in a person.
Explains how the emotions influence personal behaviour in varying ways.
Controlling emotions positively as a democratic citizen helps the wellbeing of the person as well as the society.
the_entrance: Different emotions can be expressed as happiness, sorrow, fear, anger, and love.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Introduce the concept of different emotions and their expressions.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will identify and describe the different emotions.

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Facilitate student group discussions on the consequences of emotions.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will discuss and present the consequences of emotions.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Monitoring group progress and correcting misconceptions

lesson_development_steps.teacher_activities: Guide student presentations on the importance of controlling emotions optimistically.
lesson_development_steps.student_activities: Students will present and discuss the importance of controlling emotions.
Students will answer targeted evaluation questions.
lesson_development_steps.assessment_and_feedback: Summative check for all learning outcomes

summary: Recap of key findings and core principles: Controlling emotions positively as a democratic citizen helps the wellbeing of the person as well as the society.
assessment_and_feedback_whole_lesson: Summative check or exit questions addressing all learning outcomes.
information_sources: National Institute of Education (NIE) Teacher Instructional Guide
attachments: Worksheet on Emotions and Their Consequences
